reason: Reproduced using installed uv 0.13.7 on Linux x86_64 with Python 3.12.3. Temporary fixtures were loaded with `uv --no-config --offline run --no-project --python <interpreter> --env-file <fixture> show.py`, where show.py prints selected environment variables. `DOLLAR=prefix$MISSING` became `prefix` without warning. With `A=short` and `A_PLAIN=whole`, `BARE=$A_PLAIN` became `short_PLAIN`, while `${A_PLAIN}` produced `whole`. `SPACES=foo bar` emitted a parse warning and skipped that assignment and subsequent lines; the command exited 0. Quoting or escaping spaces worked. Comparison with python-dotenv 1.0.1 confirmed different handling of these inputs. Substitution itself is intentional; reproduction does not establish every difference as a bug. The exact reported uv 0.13.6 environment was not tested. Updated $RUNNER_TEMP/issue-context/README.md with commands, results, workarounds, and inspected test coverage. Checkout files and GitHub state were unchanged.
